name: unsmell
description: Find and fix code smells in your working changes before you commit: duplication, unnamed tuples and returns, primitive obsession, boolean and algebraic blindness, long functions, if-forests, parameter bloat, data clumps, missing receivers, misplaced rules, request-scoped values threaded through methods, unparsed input, split protocols, repeated derivations, concept mixing, mixed altitude, pass-through wrappers, generic machinery written inline, and comments that narrate instead of contract, do not parse, or speak for another layer.
